name: Cain Alvey
why: SGA's own Spring 2013 election candidate booklet. The heading 'Cain Alvey' sits directly above the studio headshot, in the President section, and the biography beneath it opens by saying he currently serves as SGA Administrative Vice President, which is the office the archive records for him in 2012-13. One name, one face, one block. Native size 299x331; not upscaled.
caption_quote: Cain Alvey is a sophomore special education major from Lewisport, Kentucky. He currently serves as the SGA Administrative Vice President

name: Brad Cockrel
quality: small, full-length rather than a head-and-shoulders frame
why: SGA's own Spring 2013 election candidate booklet. The heading 'Brad Cockrel' sits directly above this photograph at the head of the Executive Vice President section, with the next candidate (Mark Reeves) and his own picture well below it. The biography is his: Illinois Valley Community College, mechanical engineering and philosophy at WKU. He is the archive's 2013-14 Chief of Staff. Native size 328x358; not upscaled.
caption_quote: Brad Cockrel, originally from Texas, attended Ottawa Township High School in Illinois.

name: Ricky Jordan
why: The Herald's 2005 SGA election special ran a grid of senate candidates, each a single mugshot with the candidate's name set in bold immediately beneath it and their own profile beside it. His is the fourth cell of the second column, labelled 'Ricky Jordan', and the profile beside it puts him in SGA and on the academic affairs committee, which is the office the archive records for him in 2005-06. Cropped to the labelled cell only. Not upscaled.
caption_quote: Ricky Jordan | Hyden freshman Ricky Jordan is in his second semester of membership in Student Government Association.

name: R. Skylar Jordan
why: The Herald's spring 2008 election page ran four candidate headshots down one column, each with the candidate's name set in large capitals in a rule immediately beneath the frame: REAGAN GILLEY, SKYLAR JORDAN, KAYLA SHELTON, KEVIN SMILEY, in that order top to bottom. This is the second frame and its label reads SKYLAR JORDAN. The profile beside it says he currently serves as SGA chief of staff, which is the office the archive records for R. Skylar Jordan. The archive already carries the same photograph for its separate 2007-08 'Skylar Jordan' record; this is the same man in the year the archive lists him as chief of staff. Extracted at the page's native embedded resolution, not upscaled.
caption_quote: SKYLAR JORDAN | Jordan, who currently serves as the SGA chief of staff, has experience on SGA
